what: a skeptic that reads the RECORD rather than the laws. selftest asks 'is each law still enforced?'; the inspector asks 'does this look like a working system?' — on real data, every cycle.

findings.title: 1 open positions crossed their target with no exit and no trail armed
findings.detail: The tape shows price at or above the target while the position is still open and carries no high-water mark. Either the exit path did not run or the trail failed to arm.
findings.action: Trace the exit path for these symbols; a crossed target must either sell or arm a trail.

findings.title: 2 symbols show repeated V-shaped round trips to the identical price
findings.detail: Price leaving a level and returning to it EXACTLY, repeatedly, is not trading — it is two sources alternating or a stale cache being re-read. This is the five-month sawtooth in both its forms.
findings.action: Check canon_keys rejections (FROZEN/DEAD/OUT_OF_HOURS) for these symbols.

findings.title: 171 exits contradict their own label
findings.detail: An exit reason is a claim about why we sold. When the number disagrees with the name, either the fill model or the label is wrong — and both mislead every audit downstream.

findings.action: Model these as RESTING orders: fill where price crossed the level, taking the worse of level and observed print.

findings.title: 55 positions were up more than 2% and still closed negative
findings.detail: Median give-back across 1794 closed trades is 1.36% of peak. A winner becoming a loser is not a market condition; it is a missing rail.
findings.action: Check the give-back governor is armed (giveback_arm_pct) and that its exits model a resting order rather than the next glance.

findings.title: 4 sleeves show a headline with the opposite sign to realized P&L
findings.detail: The headline is equity-based and includes unrealized marks. Law 1 says realized fee-paid P&L is the only score. Quoting the headline is how 'M FLOOR ARTIST is green in all four books' was said about a sleeve that was net negative.
findings.action: Judge sleeves on realized_pct. Treat the headline as mark-to-market only.

findings.title: graded 8735 closed trades against the structure at their symbol; 1 readable separations
findings.detail: This is the steering signal: which chart states preceded winners and which preceded losers. It is a CURRENT-structure approximation, not an entry-time reconstruction, so treat it as a direction to investigate rather than proof.
evidence: entries at break_intact averaged -0.37% vs -1.38% at break_broken (n=5426/178)
findings.action: Consider tightening the sleeves toward the better bucket, with a knob and an A/B.

honesty: this auditor changes no behaviour and takes no trade. Its structure patterns use CURRENT structure, not the structure at entry time, so they point at questions rather than answering them.
